q_mr: योग्य पर्याय निवडून रिकामी जागा भरा: He has been living here ___ 2015.
q_en: Fill in the blank: He has been living here ___ 2015.
e_mr: '2015' हा एक विशिष्ट वेळबिंदू (point of time) आहे, म्हणून perfect continuous tense सोबत 'since' वापरतात. 'for' कालावधीसाठी (उदा. for five years) वापरतात; 'from' ला सहसा 'to/till' लागते.
e_en: '2015' is a point of time, so perfect tenses take 'since'. 'For' is used with a period (for five years), and 'from' normally needs 'to/till'.
hook_mr: Since = सुरुवातीचा बिंदू; For = किती काळ.
hook_en: Since = starting point; For = length of time.

q_mr: योग्य पर्याय निवडून रिकामी जागा भरा: She is ___ honest woman.
q_en: Fill in the blank: She is ___ honest woman.
e_mr: 'honest' मधील 'h' उच्चारला जात नाही; शब्दाचा उच्चार स्वराने (ऑनेस्ट) सुरू होतो, म्हणून 'an'. 'a' व्यंजन-ध्वनीपूर्वी येतो; येथे विशिष्ट स्त्रीचा उल्लेख नसल्याने 'the' नाही.
e_en: The 'h' in 'honest' is silent, so the word begins with a vowel sound and takes 'an'. 'A' is for consonant sounds, and 'the' is wrong because no specific woman is meant.
hook_mr: अक्षर नव्हे, उच्चार पाहा: an hour, a university.
hook_en: Go by sound, not spelling: an hour, a university.

q_mr: 'They are building a bridge.' या वाक्याचे कर्मणी (Passive) रूप निवडा.
q_en: Choose the passive form of: 'They are building a bridge.'
o_mr: A bridge was built by them.
A bridge is built by them.
A bridge has been built by them.
A bridge is being built by them.
o_en: A bridge was built by them.
A bridge is built by them.
A bridge has been built by them.
A bridge is being built by them.
e_mr: मूळ वाक्य present continuous आहे, म्हणून passive मध्ये 'is/are + being + V3' येते: 'A bridge is being built by them.' इतर पर्याय अनुक्रमे simple past, simple present आणि present perfect आहेत — काळ बदलला आहे.
e_en: The active is present continuous, so the passive is 'is/are + being + past participle'. The other options change the tense to simple past, simple present and present perfect.

q_mr: योग्य पर्याय निवडून रिकामी जागा भरा: Neither the teacher nor the students ___ present.
q_en: Fill in the blank: Neither the teacher nor the students ___ present.
e_mr: 'neither…nor' मध्ये क्रियापद जवळच्या कर्त्याप्रमाणे (proximity rule) ठरते. जवळचा कर्ता 'the students' अनेकवचनी आहे आणि वाक्य भूतकाळात आहे, म्हणून 'were'. 'was' हा 'teacher' ला धरून केलेली चूक आहे.
e_en: With 'neither…nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject. 'The students' is plural, so 'were'. 'Was' wrongly agrees with 'teacher'.

q_mr: योग्य पर्याय निवडून रिकामी जागा भरा: If I ___ you, I would accept the offer.
q_en: Fill in the blank: If I ___ you, I would accept the offer.
e_mr: हे काल्पनिक (unreal) स्थितीचे वाक्य आहे — 'मी तू असतो तर'. अशा second conditional मध्ये सर्व कर्त्यांसोबत 'were' वापरतात. 'am', 'will be', 'have been' हे 'would accept' शी जुळत नाहीत.
e_en: This is an imaginary situation (second conditional), which takes 'were' for all subjects. 'Am', 'will be' and 'have been' do not fit with 'would accept'.

q_mr: योग्य पर्याय निवडून रिकामी जागा भरा: Hardly had he reached the station ___ the train left.
q_en: Fill in the blank: Hardly had he reached the station ___ the train left.
e_mr: 'Hardly/Scarcely … when' ही ठरलेली जोडी आहे. 'than' ही 'No sooner … than' सोबत येते, म्हणून तो सापळा आहे. 'then' आणि 'as' येथे व्याकरणदृष्ट्या चूक आहेत.
e_en: 'Hardly/Scarcely' pairs with 'when'. 'Than' belongs with 'No sooner', so it is the trap. 'Then' and 'as' are ungrammatical here.

q_mr: योग्य समानार्थी शब्द निवडा: ABANDON
q_en: Choose the synonym of: ABANDON
e_mr: ABANDON म्हणजे सोडून देणे/त्याग करणे; 'desert' चा अर्थही तोच. 'keep', 'adopt', 'cherish' यांचा अर्थ जवळ ठेवणे/स्वीकारणे असा असून ते विरुद्धार्थी आहेत.
e_en: ABANDON means to leave behind; 'desert' means the same. 'Keep', 'adopt' and 'cherish' are near-opposites.

q_mr: योग्य विरुद्धार्थी शब्द निवडा: ANCIENT
q_en: Choose the antonym of: ANCIENT
e_mr: ANCIENT म्हणजे अतिशय प्राचीन; विरुद्धार्थी 'modern' (आधुनिक). 'old', 'antique', 'archaic' हे सर्व जुने या अर्थाचे समानार्थी शब्द आहेत.
e_en: ANCIENT means very old; the opposite is 'modern'. 'Old', 'antique' and 'archaic' are all synonyms.

q_mr: योग्य समानार्थी शब्द निवडा: BENEVOLENT
q_en: Choose the synonym of: BENEVOLENT
e_mr: BENEVOLENT म्हणजे परोपकारी, दयाळू — म्हणून 'kind'. 'cruel' (क्रूर) विरुद्धार्थी आहे, तर 'lazy' व 'proud' यांचा संबंध नाही.
e_en: BENEVOLENT means well-meaning and kind. 'Cruel' is the opposite; 'lazy' and 'proud' are unrelated.
hook_mr: bene = चांगले (benefit), vol = इच्छा → चांगले इच्छिणारा.
hook_en: bene = good (benefit), vol = wish → wishing good.

q_mr: योग्य विरुद्धार्थी शब्द निवडा: SCARCE
q_en: Choose the antonym of: SCARCE
e_mr: SCARCE म्हणजे दुर्मीळ/अपुरे; विरुद्धार्थी 'abundant' (भरपूर). 'rare', 'meagre', 'scanty' हे 'कमी' या अर्थाचे समानार्थी शब्द आहेत.
e_en: SCARCE means in short supply; the opposite is 'abundant'. 'Rare', 'meagre' and 'scanty' are synonyms.

q_mr: योग्य विरुद्धार्थी शब्द निवडा: OBSTINATE
q_en: Choose the antonym of: OBSTINATE
e_mr: OBSTINATE म्हणजे हट्टी; विरुद्धार्थी 'flexible' (लवचीक, बदलायला तयार). 'stubborn', 'adamant', 'headstrong' हे सर्व हट्टी याच अर्थाचे आहेत.
e_en: OBSTINATE means stubborn; the opposite is 'flexible'. 'Stubborn', 'adamant' and 'headstrong' are synonyms.

q_mr: योग्य समानार्थी शब्द निवडा: EPHEMERAL
q_en: Choose the synonym of: EPHEMERAL
e_mr: EPHEMERAL म्हणजे अल्पकाळ टिकणारे, क्षणभंगुर — म्हणून 'transient'. 'eternal', 'permanent', 'lasting' यांचा अर्थ दीर्घकाळ टिकणारे असा असल्याने ते विरुद्धार्थी आहेत.
e_en: EPHEMERAL means lasting a very short time, so 'transient'. 'Eternal', 'permanent' and 'lasting' are opposites.

q_mr: या वाक्प्रचाराचा योग्य अर्थ निवडा: A piece of cake
q_en: Choose the meaning of the idiom: A piece of cake
e_mr: 'A piece of cake' म्हणजे अतिशय सोपे काम. इतर पर्याय शब्दशः अर्थ घेतात; वाक्प्रचाराचा अर्थ लाक्षणिक असतो.
e_en: 'A piece of cake' means something very easy. The other options take the words literally.

q_mr: या वाक्प्रचाराचा योग्य अर्थ निवडा: Break the ice
q_en: Choose the meaning of the idiom: Break the ice
o_mr: To start a conversation in an awkward situation
o_en: To start a conversation in an awkward situation
e_mr: 'Break the ice' म्हणजे अवघडलेपणा दूर करून संभाषणाला सुरुवात करणे. 'destroy' किंवा 'cool down' हे शब्दशः अर्थ चूक आहेत, आणि मैत्री संपवण्याशी त्याचा संबंध नाही.
e_en: 'Break the ice' means to ease tension and start talking. Destroying or cooling are literal misreadings; it has nothing to do with ending a friendship.

q_mr: या वाक्प्रचाराचा योग्य अर्थ निवडा: Once in a blue moon
q_en: Choose the meaning of the idiom: Once in a blue moon
e_mr: 'Once in a blue moon' म्हणजे अगदी क्वचित. 'Every night' हा उलटा अर्थ आहे, आणि पौर्णिमा किंवा वेगाशी याचा संबंध नाही.
e_en: 'Once in a blue moon' means very rarely. 'Every night' is the opposite; it is not about full moons or speed.

q_mr: या वाक्प्रचाराचा योग्य अर्थ निवडा: Burn the midnight oil
q_en: Choose the meaning of the idiom: Burn the midnight oil
o_mr: To work or study late into the night
o_en: To work or study late into the night
e_mr: 'Burn the midnight oil' म्हणजे रात्री उशिरापर्यंत अभ्यास/काम करणे (पूर्वी दिव्यात तेल जाळून). पैसा वाया घालवणे, स्वयंपाक किंवा आग लावणे हे शब्दशः अर्थ चूक आहेत.
e_en: 'Burn the midnight oil' means to work or study late at night (from oil lamps). Wasting money, cooking or setting fire are literal misreadings.

q_mr: या वाक्प्रचाराचा योग्य अर्थ निवडा: Bite the bullet
q_en: Choose the meaning of the idiom: Bite the bullet
o_mr: To face a difficult situation bravely
o_en: To face a difficult situation bravely
e_mr: 'Bite the bullet' म्हणजे टाळता न येणाऱ्या कठीण/वेदनादायक परिस्थितीला धैर्याने सामोरे जाणे. 'avoid responsibility' हा उलटा अर्थ आहे; जखमी होणे किंवा रागाने बोलणे हे चूक आहेत.
e_en: 'Bite the bullet' means to face something unpleasant with courage. 'Avoid responsibility' is the opposite; injury and anger are wrong.

q_mr: या वाक्प्रचाराचा योग्य अर्थ निवडा: Hit the nail on the head
q_en: Choose the meaning of the idiom: Hit the nail on the head
o_mr: To describe exactly what is right
o_en: To describe exactly what is right
e_mr: 'Hit the nail on the head' म्हणजे नेमके, अचूक बोलणे किंवा समस्येचे खरे कारण ओळखणे. मोठी चूक करणे हा उलटा अर्थ आहे; इतर पर्याय शब्दशः आहेत.
e_en: 'Hit the nail on the head' means to say exactly the right thing. 'Make a big mistake' is the opposite; the others are literal.

q_mr: खालील शब्दसमूहासाठी एक शब्द निवडा: One who cannot read or write
q_en: One-word substitute: One who cannot read or write
e_mr: लिहिता-वाचता न येणारी व्यक्ती म्हणजे 'illiterate' (निरक्षर). 'ignorant' म्हणजे अज्ञानी (माहिती नसलेला), 'innocent' म्हणजे निरागस, आणि 'illegible' हस्ताक्षराला लागू होतो — व्यक्तीला नव्हे.
e_en: One who cannot read or write is 'illiterate'. 'Ignorant' means lacking knowledge, 'innocent' means blameless, and 'illegible' describes handwriting, not people.

q_mr: खालील शब्दसमूहासाठी एक शब्द निवडा: The life story of a person written by himself/herself
q_en: One-word substitute: The life story of a person written by himself/herself
e_mr: स्वतःच्या जीवनाविषयी स्वतः लिहिलेले म्हणजे 'autobiography' (आत्मचरित्र). 'biography' दुसऱ्याने लिहिलेले चरित्र; 'diary' म्हणजे रोजनिशी, 'novel' म्हणजे काल्पनिक कादंबरी.
e_en: A life story written by oneself is an 'autobiography'. A 'biography' is written by someone else; a 'diary' is a daily record and a 'novel' is fiction.

q_mr: खालील शब्दसमूहासाठी एक शब्द निवडा: One who does not believe in the existence of God
q_en: One-word substitute: One who does not believe in the existence of God
e_mr: देव नाही असे मानणारा 'atheist' (नास्तिक). 'theist' देव मानणारा, तर 'agnostic' म्हणजे देव आहे की नाही हे माहीत होऊ शकत नाही असे मानणारा — हा मुख्य सापळा आहे.
e_en: One who denies God's existence is an 'atheist'. A 'theist' believes in God, and an 'agnostic' holds that it cannot be known — the main trap.

q_mr: खालील शब्दसमूहासाठी एक शब्द निवडा: An abnormal fear of water
q_en: One-word substitute: An abnormal fear of water
e_mr: hydro = पाणी, म्हणून पाण्याची भीती 'hydrophobia'. 'claustrophobia' बंदिस्त जागेची, 'acrophobia' उंचीची, तर 'xenophobia' परकीयांची भीती.
e_en: Hydro = water, so fear of water is 'hydrophobia'. Claustrophobia is fear of closed spaces, acrophobia of heights, xenophobia of foreigners.

q_mr: खालील शब्दसमूहासाठी एक शब्द निवडा: Handwriting that cannot be read
q_en: One-word substitute: Handwriting that cannot be read
e_mr: वाचता न येणारे हस्ताक्षर 'illegible'. 'illiterate' व्यक्तीसाठी वापरतात, 'eligible' म्हणजे पात्र, आणि 'inaudible' म्हणजे ऐकू न येणारे.
e_en: Writing that cannot be read is 'illegible'. 'Illiterate' applies to people, 'eligible' means qualified, 'inaudible' means cannot be heard.

q_mr: खालील शब्दसमूहासाठी एक शब्द निवडा: One who is present everywhere
q_en: One-word substitute: One who is present everywhere
e_mr: सर्वत्र असणारा 'omnipresent' (सर्वव्यापी). 'omnipotent' सर्वशक्तिमान, 'omniscient' सर्वज्ञ, तर 'omnivorous' सर्वभक्षी (सर्व प्रकारचे अन्न खाणारा).
e_en: Present everywhere = 'omnipresent'. 'Omnipotent' is all-powerful, 'omniscient' all-knowing, 'omnivorous' eating all kinds of food.
hook_mr: present = उपस्थित, potent = शक्ती, science = ज्ञान.
hook_en: present → everywhere, potent → power, sci → knowledge.

q_mr: खालील वाक्यातील चूक असलेला भाग ओळखा: He did not knew / the correct answer / to the / teacher's question.
q_en: Spot the part with an error: He did not knew / the correct answer / to the / teacher's question.
e_mr: 'did' नंतर क्रियापदाचे मूळ रूप (V1) येते, म्हणून 'He did not know' हवे. 'knew' हे भूतकाळी रूप आहे आणि 'did' आधीच भूतकाळ दाखवते. इतर भाग व्याकरणदृष्ट्या बरोबर आहेत.
e_en: After 'did', the base form is required: 'He did not know'. 'Knew' doubles the past tense already shown by 'did'. The other parts are correct.

q_mr: खालील वाक्यातील चूक असलेला भाग ओळखा: Each of the students / have submitted / the assignment / on time.
q_en: Spot the part with an error: Each of the students / have submitted / the assignment / on time.
e_mr: 'Each of + अनेकवचनी नाम' हा कर्ता एकवचनी मानला जातो, म्हणून 'has submitted' हवे. 'students' अनेकवचनी दिसल्याने 'have' बरोबर वाटते, पण क्रियापद 'Each' प्रमाणे ठरते.
e_en: 'Each of + plural noun' takes a singular verb, so it should be 'has submitted'. The plural 'students' tempts 'have', but the verb follows 'Each'.

q_mr: खालील वाक्यातील चूक असलेला भाग ओळखा: The room is full / of expensive / furnitures / bought last year.
q_en: Spot the part with an error: The room is full / of expensive / furnitures / bought last year.
e_mr: 'furniture' हे अगणनीय (uncountable) नाम आहे, त्याला 's' लागत नाही — 'furniture' हवे. information, luggage, advice ही नामेही अशीच आहेत. इतर भाग बरोबर आहेत.
e_en: 'Furniture' is uncountable and never takes 's'. Information, luggage and advice behave the same way. The other parts are fine.
hook_mr: Furniture, luggage, advice, information → कधीच 's' नाही.
hook_en: Furniture, luggage, advice, information → never plural.

q_mr: खालील वाक्यातील चूक असलेला भाग ओळखा: He likes his job / and he has been / working in this office / since five years.
q_en: Spot the part with an error: He likes his job / and he has been / working in this office / since five years.
e_mr: 'five years' हा कालावधी आहे, म्हणून 'for five years' हवे; 'since' केवळ विशिष्ट वेळबिंदूसोबत (since 2019) येतो. 'has been working' हा present perfect continuous येथे योग्य आहे.
e_en: 'Five years' is a period, so it needs 'for', not 'since' ('since' goes with a point of time like 2019). 'Has been working' is correct.

q_mr: खालील वाक्यातील चूक असलेला भाग ओळखा: One of my friend / is a doctor / who works / in Pune.
q_en: Spot the part with an error: One of my friend / is a doctor / who works / in Pune.
e_mr: 'One of' नंतर अनेकवचनी नाम येते: 'One of my friends'. क्रियापद 'is' मात्र 'One' प्रमाणे एकवचनी बरोबर आहे, म्हणून दुसरा भाग चूक नाही.
e_en: 'One of' must be followed by a plural noun: 'One of my friends'. The verb 'is' correctly agrees with 'One', so the second part is fine.
hook_mr: One of the + अनेकवचनी नाम + एकवचनी क्रियापद.
hook_en: One of the + plural noun + singular verb.

q_mr: खालील वाक्यातील चूक असलेला भाग ओळखा: Scarcely had / he entered the room / than the phone / started ringing.
q_en: Spot the part with an error: Scarcely had / he entered the room / than the phone / started ringing.
e_mr: 'Scarcely/Hardly' सोबत 'when' येते, 'than' नव्हे; म्हणून 'when the phone' हवे. 'than' ही 'No sooner' ची जोडी आहे. 'Scarcely had he' ही उलटी वाक्यरचना (inversion) बरोबर आहे.
e_en: 'Scarcely/Hardly' pairs with 'when', not 'than' ('than' goes with 'No sooner'). The inversion 'Scarcely had he' is correct.

q_mr: खालील शब्दाचा योग्य समानार्थी शब्द निवडा: 'Courage'
q_en: Choose the correct synonym of the word: 'Courage'
e_mr: 'Courage' म्हणजे धैर्य किंवा शौर्य. 'Bravery' हा त्याचा योग्य समानार्थी शब्द आहे.
e_en: 'Courage' means the ability to do something that frightens one; bravery is its correct synonym.

q_mr: खालील शब्दाचा विरुद्धार्थी शब्द निवडा: 'Transparent'
q_en: Choose the antonym of the word: 'Transparent'
e_mr: 'Transparent' म्हणजे पारदर्शक, ज्यातून स्पष्ट दिसू शकते. त्याच्या विरुद्ध 'Opaque' (अपारदर्शक) हा शब्द येतो.
e_en: 'Transparent' means allowing light to pass through so that objects behind can be distinctly seen. Its antonym is 'Opaque'.

q_mr: योग्य पर्याय निवडून रिकामी जागा भरा: He jumped ___ the river.
q_en: Fill in the blank with the correct preposition: He jumped ___ the river.
e_mr: जेव्हा गती दर्शवून आत प्रवेश केला जातो, तेव्हा 'into' या उपसर्गाचा (preposition) वापर केला जातो.
e_en: The preposition 'into' is used to express movement with direction toward the inside of something.

q_mr: खालील वाक्यातील चुकीचा भाग ओळखा: One of my best friends / are going / to Mumbai / tomorrow.
q_en: Spot the part with an error in the following sentence: One of my best friends / are going / to Mumbai / tomorrow.
e_mr: 'One of' नंतर येणारे नाम अनेकवचनी असते पण क्रियापद एकवचनी येते. येथे 'are' ऐवजी 'is' यायला हवे.
e_en: The phrase 'One of' takes a plural noun but a singular verb. Therefore, 'are' should be replaced by 'is'.

q_mr: खालील शब्दसमूहासाठी एक शब्द निवडा: 'A government by the people'
q_en: Choose the one-word substitute for: 'A government by the people'
e_mr: लोकांद्वारे चालवल्या जाणाऱ्या शासनाला 'लोकशाही' (Democracy) असे म्हटले जाते.
e_en: A system of government by the whole population or all the eligible members of a state is called Democracy.

q_mr: खालील वाक्यप्रचाराचा योग्य अर्थ निवडा: 'A blessing in disguise'
q_en: Choose the meaning of the idiom: 'A blessing in disguise'
o_mr: सुरुवातीला वाईट वाटणारी पण नंतर फायदेशीर ठरलेली गोष्ट
o_en: Something that seems bad at first but turns out to be good
e_mr: 'A blessing in disguise' म्हणजे अशी गोष्ट जी सुरुवातीला दुर्दैवी वाटते पण शेवटी ती फायदेशीर ठरते.
e_en: 'A blessing in disguise' refers to something that seems bad or unlucky at first, but results in something good happening later.

q_mr: खालील वाक्याचे अप्रत्यक्ष कथन (Indirect Speech) करा: He said, 'I am reading a book.'
q_en: Convert the following sentence into Indirect Speech: He said, 'I am reading a book.'
o_mr: He said that he is reading a book.
He said that he was reading a book.
He says that he was reading a book.
He told that he read a book.
o_en: He said that he is reading a book.
He said that he was reading a book.
He says that he was reading a book.
He told that he read a book.
e_mr: भूतकाळात दिलेल्या निवेदनात (said) 'am reading' (Present Continuous) चे 'was reading' (Past Continuous) होते.
e_en: When the reporting verb is in the past tense ('said'), the present continuous tense ('am reading') changes to the past continuous tense ('was reading').

q_mr:
दिलेले वाक्य सेंटेन्स रिअरेंजमेंटनुसार योग्य क्रमाने लावा:
P: reliable source
Q: of information
R: books are a
S: very rich and
q_en:
Rearrange the parts to form a meaningful sentence:
P: reliable source
Q: of information
R: books are a
S: very rich and
e_mr: योग्य क्रम: 'Books are a (R) very rich and (S) reliable source (P) of information (Q).' म्हणजे R-S-P-Q.
e_en: The correct logical order forms the sentence: 'Books are a very rich and reliable source of information.' (R-S-P-Q).

q_mr: योग्य पर्याय निवडून परिच्छेदातील रिकामी जागा भरा: Hard work is the ___ to success.
q_en: Fill in the blank with the appropriate word: Hard work is the ___ to success.
e_mr: इंग्रजीत 'key to success' हा एक सुप्रसिद्ध वाक्प्रचार किंवा collocation आहे, ज्याचा अर्थ यशाची गुरुकिल्ली असा होतो.
e_en: The standard collocation in English is 'key to success', meaning the essential factor for achieving success.

q_mr: दिलेल्या वाक्यावरून योग्य निष्कर्ष निवडा: 'Although he was poor, he was honest.'
q_en: Choose the correct inference from the sentence: 'Although he was poor, he was honest.'
o_mr: तो गरीब होता म्हणून अप्रामाणिक होता.
तो गरीब असला तरी प्रामाणिक होता.
तो श्रीमंत होता आणि प्रामाणिक होता.
तो गरीब आणि अप्रामाणिक दोन्ही होता.
o_en: He was dishonest because he was poor.
Despite being poor, he maintained his honesty.
He was both poor and dishonest.
e_mr: 'Although' चा वापर विरोधाभास दर्शवण्यासाठी होतो. गरिबी असूनही तो प्रामाणिक होता असा याचा अर्थ होतो.
e_en: 'Although' indicates a contrast. The sentence means that despite his poverty, he chose to remain honest.

q_mr: खालील वाक्यातील रिक्त जागा भरण्यासाठी योग्य पर्याय निवडा: 'Neither the manager nor his assistants ___ present at the meeting today.'
q_en: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank: 'Neither the manager nor his assistants ___ present at the meeting today.'
e_mr: जेव्हा दोन कर्ते 'neither... nor' ने जोडलेले असतात, तेव्हा क्रियापद सर्वात जवळच्या कर्त्यानुसार (म्हणजेच 'assistants') बदलते. 'Assistants' अनेकवचनी असल्याने अनेकवचनी क्रियापद 'are' येईल.
e_en: When two subjects are connected by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject ('assistants'). Since 'assistants' is plural, the plural verb 'are' is correct.

q_mr: खालील शब्दाचा योग्य समानार्थी शब्द निवडा: 'MANDATORY'
q_en: Choose the correct synonym of the word: 'MANDATORY'
e_mr: 'Mandatory' म्हणजे अनिवार्य किंवा सक्तीचे. त्याचा समानार्थी शब्द 'Compulsory' असा आहे.
e_en: 'Mandatory' means required by law or rules; obligatory. Its synonym is 'Compulsory'.

q_mr: खालील वाक्यातील चुकीचा भाग ओळखा: 'The cattle is grazing / in the field / peacefully / this morning.'
q_en: Spot the part with an error in the following sentence: 'The cattle is grazing / in the field / peacefully / this morning.'
e_mr: 'Cattle' हा शब्द दिसायला एकवचनी वाटतो पण तो नेहमी अनेकवचनी (Plural) वापरला जातो. त्यामुळे 'is' ऐवजी 'are' असायला हवे होते.
e_en: 'Cattle' is a collective noun that is always treated as plural. Therefore, 'is' should be replaced by 'are'.

q_mr: खालील वाक्प्रचाराचा (Idiom) योग्य अर्थ निवडा: 'To spill the beans'
q_en: Choose the meaning of the idiom: 'To spill the beans'
e_mr: 'To spill the beans' या वाक्प्रचाराचा अर्थ कोणतीतरी गुप्त माहिती किंवा गुपित चुकून किंवा अचानक उघड करणे असा होतो.
e_en: 'To spill the beans' means to reveal secret information, often unintentionally or prematurely.

q_mr: खालील वाक्यासाठी एक शब्द निवडा: 'A person who knows many foreign languages'
q_en: Choose the one-word substitute for: 'A person who knows many foreign languages'
e_mr: अनेक भाषा जाणणाऱ्या किंवा बोलणाऱ्या व्यक्तीला 'Polyglot' (बहुभाषी) म्हणतात. 'Linguist' म्हणजे भाषाशास्त्रज्ञ.
e_en: A person who knows or can use several languages is called a 'Polyglot'. A 'Linguist' is a student or expert in linguistics.

q_mr: खालील शब्दाचा विरुद्धार्थी शब्द निवडा: 'GENEROUS'
q_en: Choose the antonym of the word: 'GENEROUS'
e_mr: 'Generous' म्हणजे उदार किंवा दानशूर. त्याच्या विरुद्धार्थी शब्द 'Stingy' (कंजूष) असा आहे.
e_en: 'Generous' means showing a readiness to give more of something than is strictly necessary or expected. Its antonym is 'Stingy'.

q_mr: रिक्त जागा भरण्यासाठी योग्य पर्याय निवडा: 'Prevention is better ___ cure.'
q_en: Fill in the blank with the correct preposition: 'Prevention is better ___ cure.'
e_mr: ही एक प्रसिद्ध म्हण आहे: 'Prevention is better than cure.' (आजार झाल्यावर उपचार करण्यापेक्षा आजार होऊच न देणे बरे.) तुलनेसाठी 'than' वापरले जाते.
e_en: This is a well-known proverb: 'Prevention is better than cure.' We use 'than' for comparisons with adjectives of comparative degree.

q_mr:
दिलेल्या उताऱ्याच्या आधारावर खालील प्रश्नाचे उत्तर द्या:
'Reading is essential for intellectual growth. It broadens our horizons and enhances our vocabulary.' 
प्रश्न: According to the passage, reading helps in:
q_en:
Based on the short passage, choose the correct option:
'Reading is essential for intellectual growth. It broadens our horizons and enhances our vocabulary.' 
Question: According to the passage, reading helps in:
e_mr: उताऱ्याच्या पहिल्या ओळीत स्पष्ट म्हटले आहे की 'Reading is essential for intellectual growth.' त्यामुळे योग्य पर्याय बौद्धिक विकासाशी संबंधित आहे.
e_en: The passage explicitly states that 'Reading is essential for intellectual growth.' Therefore, the correct option is intellectual growth.

q_mr: खालील वाक्यातील चुकीचा भाग ओळखा: 'Neither of the two boys / were able to solve / the difficult puzzle / yesterday.'
q_en: Spot the part with an error in the following sentence: 'Neither of the two boys / were able to solve / the difficult puzzle / yesterday.'
e_mr: 'Neither of', 'Either of', 'Each of' यांच्यानंतर येणारे संज्ञा अनेकवचनी असते परंतु क्रियापद नेहमी एकवचनी असते. त्यामुळे 'were' ऐवजी 'was' यायला हवे.
e_en: 'Neither of', 'Either of', and 'Each of' are followed by plural nouns but take a singular verb. Therefore, 'were' should be replaced by 'was'.

q_mr: खालील वाक्यातील रिकाम्या जागी योग्य पर्याय निवडा: 'If she ___ hard, she will pass the exam.'
q_en: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank: 'If she ___ hard, she will pass the exam.'
e_mr: हे पहिल्या प्रकारच्या कंडीशनल सेंटन्सचे (First Conditional) वाक्य आहे. मुख्य वाक्य भविष्यकाळात ('she will pass') असेल, तेव्हा इफचे वाक्य साध्या वर्तमानकाळात ('studies') असते.
e_en: This is a First Conditional sentence. When the main clause is in the future tense ('she will pass'), the conditional clause takes the simple present tense ('studies').

q_mr: 'Audacious' या शब्दाचा समानार्थी शब्द कोणता?
q_en: Choose the synonym of the word: 'Audacious'
e_mr: 'Audacious' म्हणजे धाडसी किंवा साहसी. 'Brave' हा त्याचा योग्य समानार्थी शब्द आहे. बाकीचे पर्याय विरुद्धार्थी आहेत.
e_en: 'Audacious' means showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks. 'Brave' is the correct synonym.

q_mr: खालील वाक्यातील चुकीचा भाग ओळखा: 'The news / are too good / to be true / indeed.'
q_en: Spot the part with an error in the following sentence: 'The news / are too good / to be true / indeed.'
e_mr: 'News' हा शब्द जरी शेवटी 's' ने संपत असला तरी तो एकवचनी (Singular) मानला जातो. त्यामुळे 'are' ऐवजी 'is' वापरणे आवश्यक आहे.
e_en: The noun 'news' is treated as singular despite ending in 's'. Therefore, 'is' should be used instead of 'are'.

q_mr: 'Apple of one's eye' या वाक्यप्रचाराचा (Idiom) योग्य अर्थ निवडा.
q_en: Choose the meaning of the idiom: 'Apple of one's eye'
e_mr: 'Apple of one's eye' या वाक्प्रचाराचा अर्थ डोळ्याची तारा, म्हणजेच अतिशय प्रिय किंवा लाडका असा होतो.
e_en: The idiom 'apple of one's eye' refers to someone that one cherishes above all others, meaning very precious or dear.

q_mr: एकाच शब्दाचा पर्याय निवडा: 'A person who loves books' (पुस्तकांवर प्रेम करणारा किंवा पुस्तकप्रेमी)
q_en: Choose the one-word substitute for: 'A person who loves books'
e_mr: 'Bibliophile' म्हणजे पुस्तकांचा प्रेमी किंवा संग्राहक. 'Philanthropist' म्हणजे परोपकारी, तर 'Polyglot' म्हणजे बहुभाषाभाषक.
e_en: 'Bibliophile' means a person who collects or has a great love of books. 'Philanthropist' means a lover of mankind.

q_mr:
दिलेल्या उताऱ्याच्या आधारे योग्य पर्याय निवडा:
'Discipline is the foundation of success in any field. Without discipline, a person cannot achieve their goals, no matter how talented they are.'
प्रश्न: यशाचा पाया काय आहे?
q_en:
Based on the short passage, choose the correct option:
'Discipline is the foundation of success in any field. Without discipline, a person cannot achieve their goals, no matter how talented they are.'
Question: What is the foundation of success?
e_mr: उताऱ्याच्या पहिल्या ओळीत स्पष्ट नमूद केले आहे की, 'Discipline is the foundation of success in any field.'
e_en: The first line of the passage clearly states that 'Discipline is the foundation of success in any field.'

q_mr: रिकाम्या जागी योग्य शब्द निवडा: 'Prevention is better ___ cure.'
q_en: Fill in the blank with the appropriate word: 'Prevention is better ___ cure.'
e_mr: ही एक प्रसिद्ध म्हण आहे: 'Prevention is better than cure.' तुलना दर्शवण्यासाठी 'than' चा वापर केला जातो.
e_en: This is a well-known proverb: 'Prevention is better than cure.' The preposition/conjunction 'than' is used for comparisons.

q_mr: 'Ancient' या शब्दाचा विरुद्धार्थी शब्द (Antonym) कोणता?
q_en: Choose the antonym of the word: 'Ancient'
e_mr: 'Ancient' म्हणजे प्राचीन किंवा जुना. त्याच्या विरुद्धार्थी शब्द 'Modern' (आधुनिक) हा आहे.
e_en: 'Ancient' means belonging to the distant past. Its exact antonym among the choices is 'Modern'.

q_mr:
दिलेल्या वाक्याचे अप्रत्यक्ष कथन (Indirect Speech) करा:
He said to me, 'Where are you going?'
q_en:
Convert the following sentence into indirect speech:
He said to me, 'Where are you going?'
o_mr: He asked me where I was going.
He told me where you are going.
He asked me that where am I going.
He asked me where were you going.
o_en: He asked me where I was going.
He told me where you are going.
He asked me that where am I going.
He asked me where were you going.
e_mr: प्रश्नार्थक वाक्याचे इन्डायरेक्ट स्पीच करताना 'said to' चे 'asked' होते, प्रश्नसूचक शब्द (where) तसाच राहतो आणि वाक्याची रचना विधानार्थी होते ('I was going').
e_en: When converting a WH-question to indirect speech, 'said to' becomes 'asked', the question word is retained, and the verb tense shifts to the past ('I was going').

q_mr: योग्य पर्याय निवडून रिकामी जागा भरा: 'She is junior ___ me in this office.'
q_en: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank: 'She is junior ___ me in this office.'
e_mr: इंग्रजी व्याकरणाच्या नियमांनुसार junior, senior, superior, inferior यांसारख्या शब्दांनंतर 'than' ऐवजी 'to' या प्रीपोझिशनचा वापर केला जातो.
e_en: According to English grammar rules, adjectives like junior, senior, superior, and inferior are followed by the preposition 'to' instead of 'than'.

q_mr: 'Destiny' या शब्दाचा योग्य समानार्थी शब्द कोणता?
q_en: Choose the correct synonym for the word: 'Destiny'
e_mr: 'Destiny' म्हणजे नशीब किंवा भाग्य. 'Fortune' हा या शब्दाचा योग्य समानार्थी शब्द आहे.
e_en: 'Destiny' means fate or luck. 'Fortune' is the correct synonym for this word.

q_mr: खालील वाक्यातील चुकीचा भाग ओळखा: 'The scenery / of Kashmir / are very charming / indeed.'
q_en: Spot the part with an error in the following sentence: 'The scenery / of Kashmir / are very charming / indeed.'
e_mr: 'Scenery' हा अनकौन्टेबल (Uncountable) संज्ञा आहे, जी नेहमी एकवचनी मानली जाते. त्यामुळे 'are' ऐवजी 'is' वापरणे आवश्यक आहे.
e_en: 'Scenery' is an uncountable noun and is always treated as singular. Therefore, 'is' should be used instead of 'are'.

q_mr: 'Hit below the belt' या वाक्प्रचाराचा योग्य अर्थ निवडा.
q_en: Choose the meaning of the idiom: 'Hit below the belt'
o_mr: अनैतिक किंवा अयोग्य मार्गाने वार करणे
e_mr: 'Hit below the belt' या वाक्प्रचाराचा अर्थ अनैतिक किंवा अयोग्य मार्गाने (unfairly) हल्ला करणे किंवा वागणे असा होतो.
e_en: The idiom 'hit below the belt' means to act unfairly, cruelly, or in a way that violates the rules of fair play.

q_mr: एका शब्दात उत्तर द्या: 'A person who hates mankind'
q_en: Choose the one-word substitute for: 'A person who hates mankind'
e_mr: मानवतेचा द्वेष करणाऱ्या व्यक्तीला 'Misanthrope' (द्वेष करणारा) असे म्हणतात. 'Philanthropist' म्हणजे मानवतावादी.
e_en: A person who hates mankind is called a 'misanthrope'. A 'philanthropist' is a lover of mankind.

q_mr: दिलेल्या परिच्छेदातील रिकाम्या जागेसाठी योग्य शब्द निवडा: 'Water is essential ___ all living beings for survival.'
q_en: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank in the sentence: 'Water is essential ___ all living beings for survival.'
e_mr: 'Essential to' ही योग्य वाक्प्रचार रचना आहे, ज्याचा अर्थ एखाद्या गोष्टीसाठी अत्यंत आवश्यक असणे असा होतो.
e_en: The correct collocation is 'essential to', meaning absolutely necessary for something or someone.

q_mr:
खालील उताऱ्याच्या आधारावर योग्य पर्याय निवडा:
'Regular physical exercise keeps our body fit and healthy. It improves blood circulation and reduces the risk of many diseases.'
प्रश्न: Regular physical exercise helps in:
q_en:
Based on the short passage, choose the correct option:
'Regular physical exercise keeps our body fit and healthy. It improves blood circulation and reduces the risk of many diseases.'
Question: Regular physical exercise helps in:
o_mr: keeping our body fit and healthy
o_en: keeping our body fit and healthy
